metadata.note: Hand-authored: Service Bus has no Swagger for its messaging runtime. Transcribed from learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/servicebus (send-message-to-queue, send-message-batch, peek-lock-message-non-destructive-read, receive-and-delete-message-destructive-read, unlock-message, delete-message, renew-lock-for-a-message). Error matchers checked against the live service on 2026-10-23.
